question.text: Credit risk has three primary measurement components. Which of the following is NOT one of them?

explanation.text: The Logic: Basel II/III credit risk: PD × EAD × LGD = Expected Loss. Duration is an interest-rate measure, not credit. The Trap: 'Duration at Default' is a fabricated term to distract. Cross-Exam Context: III-A Compliance, XV all cover credit risk framework; XXI-B applies. Manager's Pro-Tip: Weighting PD × LGD gives expected loss; but tail risk concentrations need CVaR modelling too.
